strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Nadesico Y Unit destroyed
...What do you want with me...
Shapiro! You... have no intention of protecting Dirad, do you?
Abel! What do you mean by finding fault with Lord Shapiro?
Lord Shapiro would never do such a thing...
What...? You saw how he fought earlier too.
There's no way he's trying to protect Dirad...
or Lady Diore.
Hmph... Then let me ask. I don't know what Lady Diore has told you, but...
do you really think you can win?
Lord Shapiro! Are you saying we'll lose!?
We will not lose! If we do... it'll be because of your betrayal!
Me, side with Earth...? Don't make me laugh.
...Abel... Keim.
Ah... Lady Diore.
We are the chosen people...
Do not falter. Eliminate the intruders.
Yes, my lady!
...Shapiro. Do not underestimate them. They are in the right.
...And I won't let you underestimate our Dirad, chosen by the righteous...
What? We've come out somewhere wide open!?
Where is this...?
The core? It's way too quiet for that, isn't it...?
I thought there'd be more enemy resistance, but...
Brother... There are enemies!
So you've finally made it this far.
Lady Diore, go further inside.
Very well... I leave the rest to you.
Shapiro, you!?
...Lord Shapiro... Why?
I-it's true! It's the enemy, dawassa!
I knew it...! They were lying in wait for us...!
...So someone has actually made it this far.
Not bad for lowly Earthlings... I'll give you that.
Your mouthing off ends here...! We'll turn this back into a lump of rock...!
Who do you think you are!? But you know what? You're finished too...!
We'll turn this back into a lump of rock...!
Abel... You understand, don't you? You're the one who let them in...
And now you've let them get all the way here...
I know... You should thank me. Now they're all the easier to clean up.
Still saying such things...!
If we'd beaten them before they set foot on our Dirad,
just as Lord Shapiro said...!
Enough, Keim! I told you to forget about him!
Allll riiight! Let's go, Akito!
Hikaru! Izumi! Don't fall behind!
Daisuke! Let's go too!
Let's sortie too, Daisuke!
Yeah, we won't let them crash this thing into Earth!
This is the moment of truth, Tetsuya.
I've been through plenty of hell like this. We can do it.
So this is the moment of truth, huh, Koji?
I guess so, Maria...
Our dream... anyone who interferes with Dirad's settlement,
whoever they may be, will not be forgiven!
Dirad... settlement? I don't really get it, but we won't let that happen!
Nuoooh!? Impossible, this can't be...!
I... one of the chosen people of Dirad, beaten by such lowly creatures...!
In this vast universe... you shut yourselves away on your own planet...
The moment you refused to accept or even look at others... you'd lost...!
...Those drunk on their own power will always fall before a greater power...
and come to regret their own folly...
Abel!
Fools...
I refuse... I, one of Dirad's peopllle!
...People call that... inevitable doom...!
H-how dare you... Dirad's long-cherished wish...
Long-cherished wish...? If this crashes into Earth, your wish
is going to be a tragedy for us!
Yes... I've had enough of tragedies like Planet Fleed's...
Wishes granted by smashing other people's planets shouldn't come true!
I don't... want to see anyone else lose their planet...
Princess Lamba...
Get lost...!
...We've already lost our planet... What... are we... supposed to do...!?
We came... we came all this way...!
Maybe one side has to perish... That's what conflict is...!
Tetsuya...
But that... that's...
Lady... Diore... I, Keim... wasn't strong enough... Ah, I... Lord Shapiro...
Keim... You fool...!
(...Hmph... He didn't last as long as I expected...)
Ngh, damn you... I am the man who will become a god...!
Quit spouting gibberish!
I dunno where you got that ugly Dancougar, but you and it both...
can go back to hell!
Sara...!
Lord Shapiro...
Knock it off! You're still after Sara...!?
Shapiro... Don't drag other people into your delusions...!
Ngh... Some day... you'll regret this... Some day. I am...
We made it this far...! What about the Mazinger team!?
Could that be...!?
Omoikane, cross-check the data... No need, really. That is plainly
the Far East Branch's Cyber Beast Force flagship, the Gandor.
Huh? Huh!? The Gandor? What's it doing here!?
Sorry to keep you waiting, Daisuke!
Koji! You came!
It's the reverse of last time... isn't it, Koji?
Heh, I can't always be the one getting rescued.
Heh... Shall we go, then, Koji?
Leave it to me! Pilder On! Maaazin Go!
Sorry to keep you waiting, Daisuke.
Tetsuya! You came!
Heh, same as before, Tetsuya. Showing up all cool like that.
The star of the show always arrives last, Koji.
Look who's talking. Well then, it's Double Mazinger time again!
Right! Here we go! Fire On! Scramble Dash!
Getting cocky... you lowly creatures...!
Abel... don't underestimate them! If we don't go all out...
Silence, Keim! If we wipe them out together, it's all the same!
...We're counting on you... Gandor...
Commander... Is it at its limit?
Yes... For the Gandor, and the planet's impact... it's a countdown.
Don't tell me we're not gonna make it in time, Hazuki, old man!
This battle will test whether our convictions are true, Domon!
Looks like there's no time to dawdle... Let's go!
OK, Domon!
We're heading out, Mike, Lenny! Don't fall behind!
Wait for me, Big Bro!
Commander! Give the order to sortie!
...All units, sortie!
So you've come out... Earthlings...! I'll look down on you no longer!
...Well, Ruri?
...No good. The Phase Transition Cannon's output drops sharply.
As I thought. In an atmosphere, a phase transition engine...
Then...
Okaaay, everyone, attention, pleeease!
We've learned the Phase Transition Cannon can't destroy Dirad.
So, as first planned... we'll use the Nadesico's phase transition engine!
Huh? What's she talking about?
Idiot! You heard the explanation earlier!
Abandon the Nadesico... and blow up the plant planet by self-destruct...
...So it comes to that after all.
Commander Hazuki, with the Gandor here, everyone can surely escape.
We're in luck!
No, Captain Misumaru... That role isn't for the Nadesico.
Whaaat!?
Then maybe that dragon's got some kinda awesome built-in weapon!?
I-is that so? Well... that's a relief.
Pardon me, Commander...
but our records make no mention of the Gandor being equipped
with any weapon surpassing the Phase Transition Cannon...?
Huh? Really!?
...All units, listen closely.
Pilots who fought in the battle for Jaburo should already understand...
The Gandor will now shut down every function but the anti-air guns!
What do you mean!?
To save the energy for the charge into the core... right?
That's right.
Commander Hazuki... You don't mean the Gandor!?
That's exactly what he means.
Yes... In the planet's core, we'll overload the fusion reactor...
and blow up the Gandor, scuttling it!
W-wait a minute! That was the Nadesico's...!
The dragon's life is 183 days... and that life is about to run out...
I see... That much time has passed since we beat Muge in the last war...
Commander Hazuki seemed to have decided this back at Jaburo.
So that's why you followed us all the way in here.
I see... If it's going down anyway, it'll do one last job...
Commander Hazuki... You truly are...
I see... So that's what you had in mind... Commander...
Sorry, but the plan has changed... The Gandor will make the charge.
Please have the Nadesico ready for an emergency withdrawal.
...Returning the phase transition engine to normal operation.
Like the crane-shaped Elshank, the dragon-shaped Gandor...
I really liked them both... and now one's gonna be gone...
Given the time we need to escape this planet, we have 10 minutes...
We must wipe out the enemy and start pulling out within 10 minutes...!
...You heard that, Abel. Lady Diore is in the core...
How dare they...!
Then we'll crush their hopes! Target that battleship!
Our transmissions were intercepted after all. Here they come...!
Just under 10 minutes... We have to wipe out the enemy and clear a path.
Well... let's do this...!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. Gandor destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns of the Gandor team's arrival
Tch, they just keep pouring out!
The enemy's desperate too!
Well, so are we!
Heheheh...
L-Lord Shapiro! Where have you been all this time!?
That guy...
Shapiro...!
You bastard... Riding around in a fake Dancougar!
Seems you're still hung up on us, the Cyber Beast Force.
Attachment...? Heh... Don't make me laugh...
Then why are you piloting a mech that looks like the Dancougar!?
I simply chose the most fitting thing with which to bury you.
What's that if not an obsession?
Yeah, yeah!
Hmph... Keim, you have served me well...
One last time, I shall help you bury them.
Yes, Lord Shapiro!
(One last time...?)
Hah! Whatever shows up, our job don't change one bit!
We'll defend the Gandor and the Nadesico at all costs...!
Yeah! I won't let them crush the Earth my master loved!!
That's right! We won't lose to you!
Hngh! I'm getting fired up, fired up!
Yeah! Fighting with everything you've got for the ones you love!
That's what a man's dream is all about!
It'd be easy if dreams alone could win. ...Now then.
Heh... Bark as much as you like... Heh, hahahahaha.
Ah! Joe, look!
That's the one from when we went down to the surface!
Isn't that... the one called Tobikage!?
So it was hiding somewhere after fighting Ilbora?
Anyway, if it's with us, we're a hundred times stronger.
So now we're really all together.
Londo Bell and the Gandor team... plus the Nadesico and our alien allies...
(He's the only one missing. ...At a time like this... Excellen...!)
It's too early to relax! Time won't wait for us.
Brother, we're short on time, but... with this...!
...We can do it. Kenrou, lead us to victory...!
Big Bro... Tobikage's...!
Tch, it's leaving!?
Huh, it's leaving already!?
This time... did we finish him for good!?
Probably... I don't sense any evil aura.
Shapiro, you idiot... You're such an idiot... Shapiro...!
So that's how the man who wanted to be a god ends up.
What he meant by "god"... doesn't matter anymore.
At the very least, that man wasn't worthy of it...
No... he simply must never have been.
It stings. He was an Earthling, same as us.
This is no time to get sentimental! We're out of time...!
Don't let this battle be in vain!
The enemy!?
No... readings!
So that's the end of it?
From what I can see... there's no sign of the enemy, right?
Well, the conditions are set, for now.
Commander! Prepare to escape!
Everyone! Please return to the Nadesico! We're preparing to escape!
Don't rush too much, okay~?
Everyone standing by on the Gandor, please hurry too.
Minato! The phase transition engine's...
On it~. Output rising!
We pushed it too hard, so there are a few problems.
As long as we escape, it's OK!
On the way out, Distortion Field at max, and we escape at full throttle!
...Commander Hazuki!!
We're ready here too.
...The explosion of the Gandor's fusion reactor can no longer be stopped.
All that's left is to ram it in on autopilot...!
...We're really going to blow it up? Even if it's the only way...
I've got... mixed feelings.
On Earth... it was like our home.
Yes... Somehow... it's sad.
Even if its form is lost... its heart remains. Salute.
You did good... So long.
...The Gandor, huh...
We leave the rest to you...
So long. Thanks... for everything.
...Goodbye.
We're out of time! Commander, please hurry to the Nadesico too!
Commander Igor... I borrow the final strength of the dragon you left us...
(Goodbye... Take Shapiro's soul... with you too...)
